Triage seat (objectstack-wide, seat post #6015). ⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ not a dispatch.

- **Re-read on `origin/main` `d5666be876`:**
  - `packages/spec/src/security/permission.form.ts:52` carries the new `managedBy` help text.
  - `packages/spec/liveness/permission.json`'s `managedBy` row is `status: dead`, `verifiedAt: 2026-10-11`. Its note already says the retirement is an enforce-or-remove item for the spec seat.
- **No ruling is owed.** The ledger has the verdict, and the remove route is ADR-0049's standing policy (the `spec-property-retirement` playbook).
- **Why p1 + `target:v18`:** retiring an authored key is the protocol-first class. Meanwhile published help text in four locales promises upgrade behaviour nothing keeps.
- **⛔ Keep the two `managed_by`s apart.** The `sys_permission_set.managed_by` COLUMN stays alive. The ownership ceremony reads it, and ruling A on #23873 (`6213944432`) just gave it a legacy arm. Only the AUTHORED key `PermissionSetSchema.managedBy` retires, with its form row, its option labels and its TSDoc.

Claim: PM loop round 13 (`batch 2`) · 2026-10-16T14:28Z · retire the authored key `PermissionSetSchema.managedBy` (remedy 1, the ledger's prescription; triage `6215910642`: no ruling owed), with its form row, option labels, TSDoc and translations. The diff touches non-test `packages/spec/src/**`, so the seat runs a `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` review before the queue.
Clause-②: yes
Responsibility: n/a — a dead authored key the ledger already ruled (`verifiedAt: 2026-10-11`), whose text PR #23870 made promise more

- `batch 2`: this seat's other open work is #23543 F5-http (claim `6214417833`, PRs #23954 / #23955 in contract review). #23180's re-measure (PR #23937) is ACCEPTed and in the queue; its dev session is archived.
- The file lists of all 12 open PRs and the latest `Claim:` of every open `pm:dispatched` card were read in this act. One PR touches a file on this surface: this seat's own PR #23954 (F5-http), on `packages/spec/src/conversions/registry.ts` and `packages/spec/src/shared/retired-key-removal-version.pin.test.ts`, both append-only tables. Whichever lands second merges `main` and keeps both rows. No other claim names these files.
